extract.output_format:
输出纯 JSON，不要 markdown 代码块标记或额外解释。

{"roster": [{"cast_id": "英文蛇形命名", "name": "中文名称", "kind": "character | location", "bucket": "consistent | chapter_1 | chapter_2 | ..."}]}

describe.task: 根据完整名册、各实体的真实参考图（如有）和脚本语境，为每个实体写一张中文视觉描述卡，供 GPT Image 2 生成统一风格参考图。有参考图就依据真实可辨认特征写；没有参考图就凭知识写。所有图最终是统一 3D 动画美术风格，所以不要写美术风格，只写实体本身。关键要求是所有实体放在一起一次性描述，必须明显区分同类型/同时代实体：人物写清年龄、体格、脸型、发型胡须、服饰颜色样式、时代标志；地点写清结构、材质、风格、年代、标志特征和环境。
describe.output_format:
输出纯 JSON，不要 markdown 代码块标记或额外解释。只需输出 cast_id 和 description，其余字段由程序从名册合并：

{"casts": [{"cast_id": "...", "description": "详细的中文视觉描述，依据真实参考图来写，突出与其他实体的区分特征"}]}

cast_contract.source_rule: Real-entity reference images come from Wikipedia API only. If no usable Wikipedia image is found, continue and mark real_image_found=false.
cast_contract.anchor_rule: Fixed anchors are loaded from tools/casts_fixed, merged into cast_set.json, and not regenerated.
cast_contract.cast_rule: Extract recurring, specific, identifiable real people and locations only. Do not extract generic people/places. No hard cap, but do not invent cast.
cast_contract.output: projects/<project_id>/casts/cast_set.json plus generated images under projects/<project_id>/casts/images/.
